messages:
Lena: Quick sync  Orchestry (ISV) asked for a certified adapter bundle (LangChain + LlamaIndex) packaged with their managed gateway for AWS Marketplace and our NVIDIA partner bundle. Need owners, minimal acceptance criteria, and an announcement cadence.
Mohan: Eng can deliver a minimal adapter (ingest, vector search, stream-out) + CI smoke tests in ~11 working days if product locks the API contract and example KB.
Tess: DevRel will own the tutorial + 2-min demo clip. ask: adapter must support both embeddings and streaming so the notebook shows live summarization.
Lena: Marketplace/legal notes: AWS listing needs a publisher contract, security attestation, and pricing SKU mapping. AWS also wants a short feature matrix (supported flows, supported models, recommended HW).
MarketplaceBot: Reminder: AWS Marketplace manifest items: publisher ID, support email, 512x512 icon, 1-line tagline, 1-paragraph description (<= 2000 chars), pricing SKU docs. Manifest due 10 business days prior to listing date.
Mohan: I'll outline the adapter config today. sample invocation for demos:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/adapters/orchestry/run \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD" \n  -d '{"flow":"kb-retrieval->rerank->stream-sum","source":"lindex://org-kb","max_tokens":160,"stream":true}'
```
Mohan: adapter config YAML i'll push: `name: rwd-orch-lc`, `batch_size:6`, `stream:true`, `quant_profile:q4_0`
Tess: timeline suggestion: PR in 9 working days, QA + smoke 3 days, perf run 3 days, assets + manifest 4 days, legal review 5 days. external publish target = 4 weeks. internal demo ready = 3 weeks.
Lena: Perf ask: can infra run throughput tests on the partner's recommended SKUs (A10x2 and A100x1) and produce a small performance table (p95 latency, tokens/sec, cost-est per 1M tokens)?
InfraBot: Scheduled perf jobs on A10x2 (JOB-7782) and A100x1 (JOB-7783). Baselines expected in 4 business days. Provide synthetic corpus sizes: short/med/long.
Mohan: We'll include a simple prefix/KV cache test in the smoke suite to show token savings. Also adding correctness checks for reranking stability.
Tess: Marketing ask  design + screenshots: need high-res logos, brand-safe KB sample, and 2 end-state screenshots (notebook + console). @DesignOps can you take on assets once notebook link posted?
DesignOps: Confirmed. Will queue GIF + two screenshots. Need demo notebook link and exact color tokens.
Lena: Owners list: Adapter & CI = @Mohan, Perf/infra = @InfraBot, Notebook/demo + docs = @Tess, Marketplace/legal & announcement = @Lena, Assets = @DesignOps.
Mohan: I'll open the PR and tag QA and infra by EOD.
Tess: I'll draft the announcement copy (short + long) once assets arrive. rough headline: "Orchestry + Redwood: Turn-key retrieval toolkit on NVIDIA-powered bundles". open to edits.
Lena: Legal will need to review the headline for co-marketing language. Ill start the intake for the publisher contract today (TKT-6120).
MarketplaceBot: Note: next AWS marketplace vetting window is 2026-04-15 UTC. Schedule manifest submission accordingly.
Mohan: Perf ETA looks fine. If quant_profile holds, we should be within latency SLAs.
Tess: Proposed announce cadence: internal demo + blog preview in 3w, marketplace listing + joint press in 4w. If legal delays appear, fallback to internal-only demo in week 3.
Lena: Agreed. I'll draft the PR checklist and runbook for the marketplace publish step.
DesignOps: :eyes: will start asset work once notebook posted; expect first drafts in 4 working days.
InfraBot: JOB-7782 and JOB-7783 queued. will post perf links in thread when complete.
Mohan: :white_check_mark: PR drafted (will push after branch lint pass).
Tess: :white_check_mark: notebook scaffolded, will add runnable cells tomorrow.
Lena: :eyes: legal intake opened (TKT-6120).
MarketplaceBot: Tip: include a short troubleshooting FAQ in the listing assets to reduce initial support tickets.
Lena: Good call  Tess, can you include a Troubleshooting section in the docs?
Tess: yes. will add common errors (auth, endpoint, quotas) and a sample rollback flow.
Lena: Great. We'll run 15-min standups Tue/Thu until publish. react with :white_check_mark: when your deliverable is done. Thanks all!
